application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Consent & Permissions
processes.description: Handles user consent for research, audio playback, and webcam recording before the experiment begins.

processes.name: Data Collection (2 Sessions)
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test. User's voice, webcam video, and detailed event logs are recorded for later batch analysis.
steps: User clicks a button to start the session, which prompts for camera and microphone permission.
A stimulus word audio is played, and the event is logged with a timestamp.
User has a fixed 6-second window to speak their response; the start and end of this window are logged.
The process repeats for all words in the session.
After the first session, a break screen is shown and recording is paused.
The user starts the second session, and recording resumes.
After the second session, recordings are stopped and saved.
A detailed session log (JSON) with event timestamps is also saved.

processes.name: Backend Batch Analysis
processes.description: Asynchronous process where the collected audio and webcam video are analyzed by Hume AI.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the entire data collection flow: consent, intro, two-session loop, breaks, webcam/mic recording, and detailed event logging. Manages state via `kawasakiStore`.

dataFlows.flow: Full Experiment Execution with Webcam Recording

steps.action: User clicks 'Start Session', triggering a camera and microphone permission prompt.
Once permission is granted, webcam and mic recording starts via `MediaRecorder`.
State updates: `testStatus` to 'session-1-running', `currentWordIndex` to 0. Session start is logged.
(Loop) Stimulus audio for the current word is played. 'WordDisplayed' event is logged with timestamp and word.
(Loop) A 6-second timer for user response begins. 'ResponseWindowOpened' event is logged.
(Loop) After 6 seconds, `currentWordIndex` increments. 'ResponseWindowClosed' event is logged.
When Session 1 ends, recording is paused. A break screen is displayed.
When Session 2 ends, all recordings are stopped.
Triggers the saving of artifacts: session-1.webm (video+mic), session-2.webm (video+mic), and session-log.json via the `/api/save-artifact` endpoint.

troubleshooting.issue: Real-time speech-to-text was slow and introduced latency.
troubleshooting.resolution: Changed the architecture to a data collection model. The app now records all user responses (audio/video) locally and sends them for asynchronous batch processing. This decouples the user experience from API latency.
